purpose: handedness (h) of styxx.certify's obligation predicate, per declared mapping

population_PRINTED.what: the committed certificates, as they stand; nothing re-certified
population_PRINTED.coverage_note: 16 of 208 committed certificates carry the v1 summary and 18 carry per-token epistemics; every other certificate is silent about who handed it its targets. Absence is pre-annotation, never zero.

population_LIVE.what: every certifiable document re-certified at the current verifier

instrument_level.what: a classification PER INSTRUMENT of where its targets come from. It is a different population from the token histogram above: an instrument is one row whatever its token count, and a hypothesis about instruments (handed-target instruments collapse held-out; found-target ones do not) is tested on THIS table, never on token shares.

styxx.certify obligation predicate.target_grain_note: header-bound and n-glued obligations are structural; line-word, correlation-word and range-sanity obligations are incidental. Its held-out figure pools both; v3 unpooled them.

styxx.diffgate path-claim accuser.measured_held_out: 0.16 precision against a 0.95 floor (RESULT_v14_naming_the_defects_did_not_save_it_2026_09_01); accusing branch deleted
styxx.diffgate path-claim accuser.target_grain_note: a path-shaped string co-occurring in prose; no author commitment names it as a claim.

styxx.claimdetect STRUCT-1.target_grain_note: its structure is sentence shape the detector infers (verb stems, path tokens), not a label the author committed to.

styxx.sworn (sworn/0.1).measured_held_out: NONE — unmeasured by design of the spec; the author binds the target at write time
styxx.sworn (sworn/0.1).target_grain_note: the limiting case: the author's tag is the whole target and nothing co-occurs.

instrument_level.do_not_conflate: token-level h is a share over tokens inside one instrument; instrument-level h is a label over instruments. Drawing the test of an instrument-level hypothesis from the token histogram measures the wrong population — the one the certificates print rather than the one the hypothesis is about.
instrument_level.target_grain: a column over instruments, 2026-09-02: does the instrument take its targets from labels the author committed to (structural) or from co-occurrence it inferred (incidental)? An instrument can do both. Same population as the rows: one label per instrument, never a token share.

never_pool: PRINTED and LIVE are different populations under different verifier builds. No key in this receipt combines them, and a rate quoted from one must name it.
